errors.evidence: The description states the range for the green line (Monolingual-Ch) is 0.88 to 0.97. However, the minimum value for this line in the chart is approximately 0.91.

The description of the blue line (Monolingual-En) fails to mention that the line is not continuous and has several large gaps, for example between "Second H" and "Middle", and after "unrounded". This is a significant feature of how the data is presented.
The description claims the blue line (Monolingual-En) rises to 0.75 at "Unaspirated". However, the blue line ends at the "unrounded" category and has no data points for "Aspirated" or "Unaspirated".

The description states that the yellow line (Bilingual-Ch) reaches a peak of 0.95 at "Front 1". The chart shows the peak of ~0.95 is at the "unrounded" category, while the value at "Front 1" is approximately 0.88.
The description states the value for the yellow line (Bilingual-Ch) at "Unaspirated" is 0.75. The value shown in the chart is closer to 0.78.
The description states the range for the orange line (Bilingual-En) is 0.78 to 0.90. The actual range shown in the chart is approximately 0.80 to 0.93.

The description claims the orange line (Bilingual-En) rises to 0.90 at "Unaspirated". However, the orange line ends at the "unrounded" category and has no data points for "Aspirated" or "Unaspirated".
